title: advanced paste shortcut keyboard modifier (WIN key) not releasing subsequent keystrokes open loads of windows shortcuts

judgment.rationale: A maintainer already asked the reporter to confirm whether the Advanced Paste hotkey issue still reproduces on 0.100.2, and the reporter replied that they updated and would report back if it still happens.
evidence: The issue was filed against 0.98.1 and describes the Win key becoming effectively stuck after using a custom Win+Z Advanced Paste shortcut.
Maintainer comment: “Should be fixed in the latest update in my experience (0.100.2).”
Reporter reply: “have just updated ... will report back if still present.”
judgment.recommended_action: Wait for the reporter to confirm whether the problem still reproduces on 0.100.2 before proposing new Advanced Paste work.

fix_assessment.rationale: The next decision depends on current-build confirmation rather than a new code proposal, because the only public follow-up says the issue may already be fixed in 0.100.2.

issue_context.summary: The reporter says a custom Advanced Paste shortcut using Win+Z sometimes leaves the Win key effectively stuck, but a maintainer believes 0.100.2 already fixed it and the reporter has not yet confirmed whether the bug still exists after updating.
known_information: The original report came from PowerToys 0.98.1 using a Microsoft Store install.
The reported symptom is modifier-key state leakage after invoking a custom Advanced Paste hotkey that uses the Win key.
A maintainer explicitly reported that the behavior appears fixed in 0.100.2.
The reporter acknowledged the update and said they would follow up only if the bug remained.
inferences: The issue is currently blocked on confirmation, not on a missing initial triage pass.
If the reporter comes back with a fresh current-build repro, the likely area remains AdvancedPasteModuleInterface modifier release and restore handling.
issue_context.analysis: This should remain in waiting-on-author rather than cycling another generic request. The live thread already contains a specific maintainer ask and a reporter promise to retest on the newer build, so the bounded revalidation pass should preserve that wait state honestly.
initial_investigation: Advanced Paste currently contains explicit modifier release and restore logic in src/modules/AdvancedPaste/AdvancedPasteModuleInterface/dllmain.cpp, including Win-key handling and a dummy key-up to avoid Start menu activation.
No newer reporter confirmation, linked fix, or reopened failure evidence has been added since the retest request.

information_gaps.information: Whether the same Win-key-stuck behavior still reproduces on PowerToys 0.100.2 or newer.
information_gaps.why_needed: That answer decides whether this stays handled-by-update or returns to active bug triage.
information_gaps.how_to_collect: Retest the same custom Win+Z shortcut on the current build and reply only if the issue is still present.

author_wait_evidence.author: ReginaldTang
author_wait_evidence.requested_evidence: Confirm on PowerToys 0.100.2 whether the Win-key-stuck behavior still reproduces after updating.
